sections.title: ARCH Summer Institute: Physics for Architects
sections.description: This is a non-credit course for entering Master of Architecture students. The course will cover the following: mechanics, heat, light, sound and electricity. The course will satisfy the physics pre-requisite condition for matriculation in the fall. Course enrollment is by permit only.
